content.what_it_is: FOAM-conditional Fortran module defining a transported surface-foam thickness, foam velocity, source/sink models, physical/MPI boundary exchange, upwind reconstructed foam fluxes, and an optional wet/dry foam mask. It allocates and initializes module arrays (lines 40-272), advances source/sink and advection plus air-water drag (lines 274-367), applies boundaries (lines 369-433), constructs fluxes (lines 435-492), and updates the mask (lines 494-539).
entities: allocatable foam state and work arrays EtaFoam through SourceM @19-28
allocatable surface and foam-depth arrays Usurf1 through DepthFoam @20-23

equations.ref: legacy USE_BURSTRATE source/sink branch at lines 291-292

io.name: defaults and selected values to units * and 3

calls: READ_FLOAT for PLOT_INTV_FOAM, BurstRate, f_source, FoamTimeScale, BurstTimeNonBreaking, MinThick, TransferRate, CdFoam @77,98,121,141,161,183,204,227
unresolved: Host/use association collision: MOD_FOAM defines its own parameter SMALL at line 36, but contained INITIALIZATION_FOAM explicitly USE-associates GLOBAL::SMALL with the same local name at line 59. Whether this compiles depends on nonstandard conflict handling; standard-conforming builds may reject the duplicate association (lines 36,57-64).

Velocity-increment limiter is algebraically inconsistent with its subsequent additive update: when Uadd exceeds the remaining difference, line 354 assigns Uadd=Usurf rather than Usurf-UFoam, and line 357 then adds that full surface velocity to the existing foam velocity. The same defect occurs for V at lines 355 and 358, so the purported cap can overshoot instead of landing on the target (lines 350-358).

Under PARALLEL, INITIALIZATION_FOAM repeatedly references myid in its diagnostics, but neither the module-level GLOBAL ONLY list at lines 3-8 nor the subroutine GLOBAL ONLY lists at lines 59-62 import myid. Compilation therefore relies on an undocumented transitive/public association through INPUT_READ at line 64.

FOAM_UPDATE uses face fluxes MxFoam/MyFoam at lines 325-333 before this routine itself constructs them; FOAM_FLUX is a separate routine at lines 435-492 and is not called here. Correctness depends on an external call order FOAM_FLUX -> FOAM_UPDATE that this module does not enforce.
EtaFoamMax is reset and updated at lines 302 and 308 but never read elsewhere in this module after initialization, leaving its intended coupling/output unresolved.
